checks.requirement: Current revision, saved before-copy, actual metadata and matched camera captures
Three proposed silhouettes compared; approved design recognizable at small size
Coherent facial/neck forms; character identity and eye direction preserved
Shaped shoulder/chest surfaces; intended sharp edges without unintended faceting
Convex face, clear crest, plausible grip/back and eye clearance
Blade cross-section, bevel/taper, guard and grip read in oblique views
Palm, fingers, thumb and wrist read as coherent grip without stacked-loop appearance
Layering, folds, material boundaries and quiet low-priority details
Real surface content, appropriate normals/data color spaces and matched Unreal interpretation
No obsolete count-based surgery; silhouette/deformation support and measured geometry
Rest/bone/socket compatibility or reviewed isolated retarget migration
All seven clips reviewed continuously and at extrema, with real evidence
Candidate import plus normal gameplay/crowded encounter inspection
Actual screen-distance comparisons and transitions, not ratio-only acceptance
Deliberate source change/reimport preserves expected references and appearance
Measured actual target hardware/preset and busy-fight cost; no inferred mobile results

promotion.reason: Actual visual, technical and human approvals have not been performed.

notice: This template is not a schema-enforced validator or evidence of asset quality. Fill only from actual inspection.
